title: по- and с- with ходить, ездить, летать

blocks.text: Adding a prefix to the repeated function verbs: **ходить**, **ездить**, **летать** usually does not form the perfective aspect but merely changes the meaning of the original verb. However, prefixes "**по**-" and "**с**-" may form the perfective aspect with the "repeated function" verbs.

points: Prefix "**по**-" denoting a perfective action of limited duration (an action "for a while"): **походить**, **поездить**, **полетать**. *Он походил по комнате и сел за стол. Мы поездили по городу и поехали домой.*

Prefix "**с**-" implying a single round trip: **сходить**, **съездить**, **слетать**. These verbs denote a single trip (going to and coming from a place), especially when a quick return is implied. *Мне надо сходить на почту за письмами. Я съезжу на вокзал и узнаю, когда отходит поезд.*

blocks.text: From the DLI Grammar Reference Book, Lesson 63.
Further sentences, so that every pattern above is practised: from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR), with their English.

exercises.q: Мы до сих ___ (пора) многого не знаем о неандертальцах.
exercises.prompt: There are still many things we don't know about the Neanderthals.
exercises.why: **пора → пор** (gen. pl.: до + genitive). Declines like газета. Ending -а → — (no ending).

exercises.prompt: There is no one standard for beauty.
exercises.why: **стандарт → стандарта** (gen. sg.). Declines like дом. Ending — (no ending) → -а.

exercises.prompt: Test pilots are constantly tempting fate.
exercises.why: **судьба → судьбу** (acc. sg.). Feminine. Declines like газета. Ending -а → -у.

exercises.q: Том на улице играет со ___ (свой) собакой в фрисби.
exercises.prompt: Tom is outside playing frisbee with his dog.
exercises.why: **свой → своей** (instr. sg. f., agreeing with собакой: со + instrumental). Declines like мой. Ending -я → -ей.

exercises.prompt: After a short pursuit, the police caught him.
exercises.why: **поймать → поймала** — past tense, fem.: drop -ть, add -ла.

exercises.q: Том впадает в экстаз, просто ___ (повторять) раз за разом слово "горностай".
exercises.prompt: Tom gets high just from saying the word 'stoat' over and over.
exercises.why: **повторять → повторяя** — gerund (деепричастие) of an imperfective verb: present stem + -я; the action goes on at the same time as the main verb.
